verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ Ọnana vwọ wan nu ka ta ki Josẹf nẹ, Nighe, ọsẹ wẹn herọ mwa, Etiyin ọ da reyọ emọ rọye ivẹ, Manasse vẹ Ifrem
verses.text_romanized: re onana vwo wan nu ka ta ki josef ne nighe ose wen hero mwa etiyin o da reyo emo roye ive manasse ve ifrem

verses.text_urhobo: Ka vuẹ Jekọp nẹ, Ọmọ wẹn Josẹf rhe mrẹ wẹ; Etiyin Izrẹl da vwẹ ẹgbẹgba vrẹn, o de Tidia ehwa.
verses.text_romanized: ka vue jekop ne omo wen josef rhe mre we etiyin izrel da vwe egbegba vren o de tidia ehwa

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta ki Josẹf, Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba vwẹ oma phia kẹ vwẹ vwi Luz vwẹ otọ ri Kenan o da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ,
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ki josef oghene ro vwo egba vwe oma phia ke vwe vwi luz vwe oto ri kenan o da ne erhovwo ke vwe

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ta kẹ vwẹ, Nighe, mi ru we ogbaọmiovwọ, ki mi ru we bu, ki mi ru we urogho rẹ ihwo, ke Me vwẹ otọ na kẹ uvwiẹ wẹn rọ cha vwẹ obuko wẹ re ọ dia ẹkẹn rayen bẹdẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke vwe nighe mi ru we ogbaomiovwo ki mi ru we bu ki mi ru we urogho re ihwo ke me vwe oto na ke uvwie wen ro cha vwe obuko we re o dia eken rayen bede

verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana emọ wẹn ivẹ na, ru wo vwẹriẹ vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na tavwe re Me ke rhe Ijipt na, e mẹ; Ifrem vi Manasse ke dia e mẹ, kirobo ri Rubẹn vi Simiọn epha.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana emo wen ive na ru wo vwerie vwe oto re ijipt na tavwe re me ke rhe ijipt na e me ifrem vi manasse ke dia e me kirobo ri ruben vi simion epha

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ rẹ ayen che vwiẹ ejobi ke dia ewẹn; ka vwẹ odẹ rẹ emesẹ rayen vwo se ayen vwẹ ẹdia rẹ uku rayen.
verses.text_romanized: emo re ayen che vwie ejobi ke dia ewen ka vwe ode re emese rayen vwo se ayen vwe edia re uku rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Kidie ọke mi vwo nẹ Padan cha, Rachel da va vwẹ abọ ghwu vwẹ otọ ri Kenan vwẹ idjerhe, yẹ asan na vẹ Ephrat ji oshesheri, mi de sho vwẹ idjerhe rẹ Ephrat (kọye Bẹtlẹhẹm).
verses.text_romanized: kidie oke mi vwo ne padan cha rachel da va vwe abo ghwu vwe oto ri kenan vwe idjerhe ye asan na ve ephrat ji oshesheri mi de sho vwe idjerhe re ephrat koye betlehem

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Izrẹl vwọ mrẹ emọ ri Josẹf, ọ da ta, Ena amono?
verses.text_romanized: oke re izrel vwo mre emo ri josef o da ta ena amono

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Ena emọ mẹ, rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vwọ kẹ vwẹ etinẹ. Ọ da ta kẹ, Reyọ ayen rhe vwe, Me rẹ wẹ, rere Me nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: josef da ta ke ose roye ena emo me re oghene vwo ke vwe etine o da ta ke reyo ayen rhe vwe me re we rere me ne erhovwo ke ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana ẹro rẹ Izrẹl djeri fiki rẹ oghwo, o gbi jọ mrẹrẹ-ẹ. Etiyin Josẹf da reyọ ayen kẹrẹ; ọ da fiọnfiọn ayen unu ọ da gbanọ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana ero re izrel djeri fiki re oghwo o gbi jo mrere e etiyin josef da reyo ayen kere o da fionfion ayen unu o da gbano ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Izrẹl da ta ki Josẹf, Mi gbi roro jovwo nẹ Me mrẹ opharo wẹn vẹrhe-e, gbe nighere, Ọghẹnẹ kọye jabọ Me sa vwọ mrẹ emọ wẹn rhe.
verses.text_romanized: izrel da ta ki josef mi gbi roro jovwo ne me mre opharo wen verhe e gbe nighere oghene koye jabo me sa vwo mre emo wen rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf de mu ayen nẹ igbo rọye, o de diguẹ bọvwọ opharo rhu otọ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef de mu ayen ne igbo roye o de digue bovwo opharo rhu oto

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da reyọ ayen ivẹ na, Ifrem da obọrhe rọye kọye obọhwẹre rẹ Izrẹl, Manasse da obọhwẹre rọye kọye obọrhe rẹ Izrẹl, o de si ayen kẹrẹ.
verses.text_romanized: josef da reyo ayen ive na ifrem da oborhe roye koye obohwere re izrel manasse da obohwere roye koye oborhe re izrel o de si ayen kere

verses.text_urhobo: Izrẹl da riẹn obọrhe rọye vwọ kpahe Ifrem uyovwi, rọ dia omotete, ọ da ghwẹ obọhwẹre rọye kpahe uyovwi ri Manasse ọ da vwẹ obọ wan ohwohwo, kidie Manasse ọye ọwanra.
verses.text_romanized: izrel da rien oborhe roye vwo kpahe ifrem uyovwi ro dia omotete o da ghwe obohwere roye kpahe uyovwi ri manasse o da vwe obo wan ohwohwo kidie manasse oye owanra

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ nẹ ẹrhovwo ki Josẹf, ọ da ta, Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Ebraham vẹ Aizik rẹ esẹ mẹ yan nene, Ọghẹnẹ ro sun vwe vwẹ akpọ mẹ rhi te nonẹ,
verses.text_romanized: o ne erhovwo ki josef o da ta oghene re ebraham ve aizik re ese me yan nene oghene ro sun vwe vwe akpo me rhi te none

verses.text_urhobo: amakashe rọ tan vwẹ nẹ idẹbono ejobi, bruphihọ kẹ emọ nana; jẹn odẹ mẹ wan oma rayen va phia, kugbe odẹ rẹ esẹ mẹ Ebraham vẹ Aizik; jẹn ayen bu phihọ ẹgborho vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: amakashe ro tan vwe ne idebono ejobi bruphiho ke emo nana jen ode me wan oma rayen va phia kugbe ode re ese me ebraham ve aizik jen ayen bu phiho egborho vwe enu re akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Josẹf vwọ mrẹ ọsẹ rọye rọ ghwẹ obọrhe rọye kpahe uyovwi rẹ Ifrem, o rhe je-e, ọ da kpare obọ rẹ ọsẹ rọye, nẹ uyovwi rẹ Ifrem re phihọ ọ ri Manasse.
verses.text_romanized: oke ri josef vwo mre ose roye ro ghwe oborhe roye kpahe uyovwi re ifrem o rhe je e o da kpare obo re ose roye ne uyovwi re ifrem re phiho o ri manasse

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Ọ dia ọtiọye-e, baba, fikiridie Ọnana ọye ọmọkpako, Ghwẹ obọrhe wẹn kpahe uyovwi rọye.
verses.text_romanized: josef da ta ke ose roye o dia otioye e baba fikiridie onana oye omokpako ghwe oborhe wen kpahe uyovwi roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọsẹ rọye da sen tanẹ, Me riẹnre mọmẹ, Me riẹnre, okpuyovwi rọye je cha dia ohwo rhe, ọ je cha rho; dede na oniọvo rọye rẹ otete na cha rhonọ, uvwiẹ rọye che hirhe ẹgborho rode.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ose roye da sen tane me rienre mome me rienre okpuyovwi roye je cha dia ohwo rhe o je cha rho dede na oniovo roye re otete na cha rhono uvwie roye che hirhe egborho rode

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye kọye ọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ ayen vwẹ ẹdẹ yena tanẹ, Oma wẹ yẹ Izrẹl wan nẹ ẹrhovwo tanẹ, Ọghẹnẹ ru we kiri Ifrem vi Manasse; kẹ etiọye ọ vwẹ Ifrem ka obaro ki Manasse.
verses.text_romanized: otioye koye o ne erhovwo ke ayen vwe ede yena tane oma we ye izrel wan ne erhovwo tane oghene ru we kiri ifrem vi manasse ke etioye o vwe ifrem ka obaro ki manasse

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Izrẹl da ta ki Josẹf, Nighe, mi muegbe rẹ ughwu re, ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ nene uwe dia, rọ je vwo wẹ rhivwi rhi te otọ rẹ esẹ wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin izrel da ta ki josef nighe mi muegbe re ughwu re ekevuovo oghene nene uwe dia ro je vwo we rhivwi rhi te oto re ese wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ rọ ma rho ejobi Me vwọ kẹ wẹ ọ dia emesẹ wẹ-ẹn, ọghwrọrọ ọvo re Me vwẹ ọlọkọ vẹ umurhabọ mẹ vwọ reyọ mie ihwo rẹ Amọr.
verses.text_romanized: o ro ma rho ejobi me vwo ke we o dia emese we en oghwroro ovo re me vwe oloko ve umurhabo me vwo reyo mie ihwo re amor

headings.text_urhobo: Jekọp nẹ Ẹrhovwo kẹ Ifrem kugbe Manasse
headings.text_romanized: jekop ne erhovwo ke ifrem kugbe manasse
